title: Jacobi descent charts and logarithmic quotient coordinates for split symmetric spaces
summary: Let $F$ be a non-Archimedean local field of characteristic zero and residue characteristic different from $2$, and let $(G,H)$ be an equal-rank split symmetric pair with $G$ split semisimple and adjoint and with an $F$-split maximal $θ$-split torus. Motivated by the singular contribution near the nilpotent fiber on the $θ$-fixed side of the infinitesimal local relative trace formula, we construct finite descent charts for regular families in $\mathfrak h$ approaching that fiber.
